WITH kalemler AS (
    SELECT sk.siparis_id,
           sk.urun_id,
           sk.adet - COALESCE(i.iade_adet, 0) AS net_adet
    FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT siparis_id, urun_id, SUM(adet) AS iade_adet
        FROM iadeler
        GROUP BY siparis_id, urun_id
    ) i ON i.siparis_id = sk.siparis_id AND i.urun_id = sk.urun_id
),
netler AS (
    SELECT k.urun_id,
           SUM(k.net_adet) AS net_satis_adedi,
           ROUND(SUM(k.net_adet * sk.birim_fiyat), 2) AS net_ciro
    FROM kalemler k
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON sk.siparis_id = k.siparis_id AND sk.urun_id = k.urun_id
    GROUP BY k.urun_id
)
SELECT u.ad,
       n.net_satis_adedi,
       printf('%.2f', n.net_ciro) AS net_ciro
FROM netler n
JOIN urunler u ON u.id = n.urun_id
ORDER BY n.net_ciro DESC, u.ad ASC
LIMIT 5;
